ranking_reference: scikit-learn 1.7.2 AP, trapezoidal PR-AUC, ROC-AUC and unpruned ROC recall at FPR <= 0.01
probability_reference: Independent vectorized confusion-count, Brier and clipped log-loss formulas at fixed threshold 0.5
retrieval_reference: Independent symmetric 28-seller score matrices; stable descending cosine and ascending seller UID; binary relevance MRR, MAP, Recall and NDCG at 1/3/5/10
bootstrap_reference: 9999 paired development-world resamples conditional on three frozen paired training runs; PCG64 seed 20260940; linear quantiles
scope_limitations: Saved-score verification reuses the frozen Chinese development evaluation and does not perform new training or selection.
Training correctness combines the unchanged reviewed implementation, prior real runtime checks and formal update/replay receipts; this audit does not repeat GPU training.
Intervals quantify development-world variation conditional on three registered paired runs, not new training seeds or subsets.
Synthetic Chinese development results do not establish real Chinese market performance or blind transfer confirmation.
